summary: Backend + Frontend tests for per-row quarantine restore (POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/pricing-restore) and Admin Listings quarantine filter/badge/undo UI. All 5 backend pytest cases passed. All frontend Playwright assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile card variant (ListingsTab.jsx ~L1085-1110) shows the mobile quarantine badge but does NOT include a per-row restore button — desktop only. This matches the review spec (which only asks for the mobile badge), but for parity consider adding a mobile restore action too.
handleRestoreSingle uses a single `restoringId` guard that prevents concurrent restores across rows — intentional serialization, worth documenting.
test_credentials: admin@rental.com / Admin123!, owner@test.com / Test1234!, renter@test.com / Test1234!
seed_data_creation: 2 quarantined properties with title prefix '[QUARANTINE-DEMO]' seeded via /app/backend/tests/seed_quarantined_demo.py for the UI test; cleaned up after run. Backend pytest fixture creates 3 rows with same prefix and cleans up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-row restore endpoint POST /api/admin/properties/{id}/pricing-restore verified: admin -> {restored:true,id,message} + is_hidden cleared + pricing_review_reason unset via GET /api/admin/properties; 404 unknown id; idempotent no-op {restored:false,message:'Listing was not quarantined.'} on non-quarantined; owner+renter 403. Frontend: quarantined chip [data-testid=quarantined-filter-on] filters table + syncs ?quarantined=1 to URL; rose badge [data-testid=quarantine-badge-<id>] renders with reason ('no price'/'low rent'); Undo2 button [data-testid=restore-quarantined-<id>] triggers window.confirm + removes row after success; mobile badge [data-testid=quarantine-badge-mobile-<id>] renders at 390px viewport.
verified_behaviors: POST restore on quarantined row returns {restored:true,id,message}; DB is_hidden=false, pricing_review_reason removed
POST restore on non-quarantined row -> 200 {restored:false, message:'Listing was not quarantined.'}
Quarantined chip visible + enabled + shows count (2)
Chip click adds quarantined=1 to URL and filters table to exactly 2 seeded rows
Rose badge on each row with correct reason label ('no price', 'low rent')
Green Undo icon per row; after confirm-accept it removes the row from filtered view
Mobile viewport (<768px) renders quarantine-badge-mobile-<id> for remaining quarantined row
